app.name: UniSlot
app.tagline: Evening timetables with the fewest clashes
solve.title: Create a timetable
solve.subtitle: Add your enrollment workbook. UniSlot builds the evening timetable with the fewest clashing students.
solve.quick.hint: About a second. Good for a first look.
solve.standard.hint: A few seconds. Recommended for most workbooks.
solve.thorough.hint: About ten seconds. Finds the fewest clashes.
solve.saturday.hint: Off keeps the week Monday to Friday.
solve.prove.hint: Afterwards an exact solver runs until it has proven that no timetable with fewer clashing students exists. This can take several minutes on a large workbook.
solve.saturday.codes.hint: Optional. Course codes separated by commas; these may use Saturday even when mathematics may not.
solve.s1.title: Choose your enrollment workbook
solve.s1.lead: Select the Excel file that lists every student and the courses they are enrolled in.
solve.s2.title: How carefully should UniSlot search?
solve.s2.lead: A longer search can find a timetable where fewer students have a clash.
solve.s3.title: Should any courses be held on Saturday?
solve.s3.lead: Most timetables run Monday to Friday. You can open Saturday for mathematics or for particular courses.
solve.prove.no.hint: Faster. You get the best timetable the search found.
solve.sat.no.hint: Every course is placed on a weekday evening.
solve.sat.yes: Yes, allow mathematics courses on Saturday
solve.sat.yes.hint: Mathematics courses may be placed on Saturday evening.
solve.summary.title: Your choices
solve.running.title: Building your timetable
solve.running.hint: Please keep this window open. This can take a few minutes.
